title: Prerequisites are built left to right
objective: Order the prerequisites of the all target so that make builds one, then two, then three.
hint: Every prerequisite has to be finished before the commands of the target run, and make works through the list from left to right.

steps.description: the prerequisites run in the order they are listed
steps.stdout:
echo "one" >> order.txt
echo "two" >> order.txt
echo "three" >> order.txt
cat order.txt
one
two
three

steps.description: the file records that same order
the target's own command ran last

lesson.goal: Observe that make traverses the graph in dependency order.
lesson.prediction: When all: one two three, what is the output order of the three recipes?
hints: The precondition of all is the entry point of the construction sequence.
Write one, two, and three to the right of the colon in the desired order.
The output order of recipes can help you verify your dependency graph.
lesson.explanation: make will first process the preconditions and then return to the target; preconditions at the same level are accessed in the order of writing.
